title: wg: protocol-06 §5.3 FanoutMessage selects content type on wire_format
description: Erratum. L1935-1949 selects on message.wire_format with arms application, welcome, proposal, commit; except welcome these are content types, and a proposal or commit can be PublicMessage or SemiPrivateMessage. mimid maps welcome->mls_welcome, application->PrivateMessage, proposal/commit->content_type of a PublicMessage (decision mimid-1wgh.5.24). Fix: select on wire_format then content_type.
